subtitle: Personal Intelligence OS Companion
description: NEXUS Mobile Companion connects your mobile device and smartwatch to your self-hosted NEXUS assistant. Monitor active missions, approve sensitive actions with tactile security, dictate prompts, and control connected devices in your private workspace.

reviewNotes.demoInstructions: NEXUS connects to a local self-hosted server via QR code pairing or manual server URL entry. It does not require a proprietary central account.
reviewNotes.privacyCompliance: Zero tracking, zero third-party telemetry, all credentials stored exclusively in iOS Keychain.
